row.evidence: PracticePanther sells Solo ($49), Essential ($69), Business ($89) and Business Pro ($114) per user/month with no SSO or SCIM listed; admins deactivate users by toggling "Active User" to "No" in Settings > Users.
row.notes: New row. Legal practice-management software (category: Vertical SaaS, as there is no legal-practice bucket; Legal, Contracts & Compliance is the alternative). No SCIM, SAML or OIDC at any tier: the pricing page, security page and Intercom help centre (searches for scim, sso, saml, okta, single sign, azure return no relevant article) describe no single sign-on option. Users are added and deactivated by hand in Settings > Users; deactivated users cannot log in and their work stays. Prices are the annual figures shown by default (monthly: $59/$79/$99/$124). 'Zapier & API' is ticked only on Business and Business Pro, and API access is approved case by case through support, so the user API is gated (api_tax true). The v2 API (OAuth 2, OData) has list/get users and a DELETE users operation whose example returns is_active false; there is no create-user operation. The paid Solo tier is priced per user, so it is taken as the team plan; the separate free-for-life plan is for sole practitioners. Status none by absence.
